items.title: Police arrest Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan's sister ahead of march
items.standfirst: Police have arrested Aleema Khan, the sister of Pakistan's jailed ex-prime minister Imran Khan at her house in Lahore, according to a spokesperson from his political party.
